en: The Principality of Svaneti as a principality in the mountains of Georgia
Its rule by the Dadeshkeliani family and its incorporation into the Russian empire
zh: 斯瓦涅季公国是格鲁吉亚山区的公国
由达杰什凯利亚尼家族统治，后并入俄罗斯帝国

politics.zh: 斯瓦涅季公国是格鲁吉亚山区的公国，位于大高加索南坡的斯瓦涅季地区，15世纪在格鲁吉亚王国解体后形成，由本地王公家族统治，以梅斯蒂亚一带为中心。它控制山口的通道与山地牧场，与伊梅列季、明格列尔及后来的俄国互动；19世纪中叶被俄国征服，其王公被废黜，领地并入俄国的高加索行政区。
politics.en: The Principality of Svaneti was a principality in the mountains of Georgia, in the Svaneti region on the southern slopes of the Greater Caucasus, formed in the fifteenth century as the Georgian kingdom broke up and ruled by local princely families with Mestia and its surroundings as its centre. It controlled the mountain passes and pastures and interacted with Imereti, Mingrelia and later Russia; in the middle of the nineteenth century it was conquered by Russia, its princes deposed and its lands incorporated into the Russian administration of the Caucasus.

economy.zh: 经济以山地畜牧、季节性转场、蜂蜜与木材以及山口通道的通行收益为基础，高山牧场支撑牛羊养殖，村落以石砌塔楼与梯田为特色，与低地的粮食和盐交换是生活必需。
economy.en: The economy rested on mountain herding, seasonal transhumance, honey and timber and income from the mountain passes, with high pastures supporting cattle and sheep, villages characterised by stone towers and terraces, and exchange with the lowlands for grain and salt a necessity of life.

culture.zh: 斯瓦涅季保存独特的地方语言与口传传统，石砌防御塔楼被列为世界遗产，东正教教堂与壁画留下遗存，血亲复仇与村落议事制度见于记载，与格鲁吉亚主流文化既有联系又有差异。
culture.en: Svaneti preserves a distinctive local language and oral tradition, its stone defensive towers being listed as World Heritage, Orthodox churches and frescoes surviving as remains, blood feud and village assembly institutions being recorded, and its culture both linked to and distinct from that of mainstream Georgia.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪公国的形成、与伊梅列季及明格列尔的关系、18至19世纪的内部分裂，以及19世纪中叶被俄国征服与领地并入，这些事件决定了斯瓦涅季的现代归属。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the principality in the fifteenth century, its relations with Imereti and Mingrelia, its internal divisions in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries and its conquest by Russia in the middle of the nineteenth with the incorporation of its lands, events that determined the modern allegiance of Svaneti.

value.zh: 位于大高加索南坡的斯瓦涅季地区。
value.en: It lay in the Svaneti region on the southern slopes of the Greater Caucasus.

value.zh: 石砌防御塔楼被列为世界遗产。
value.en: Its stone defensive towers are listed as World Heritage.

en: The Sarbadars as a movement and state in Khorasan after the collapse of the Ilkhanate
Its rule from Sabzavar in the fourteenth century and its overthrow by Timur
zh: 萨尔巴达尔是伊儿汗国瓦解后在呼罗珊兴起的政权
14世纪以萨布泽瓦尔为中心，后被帖木儿推翻

politics.zh: 萨尔巴达尔是伊儿汗国瓦解后在呼罗珊兴起的政权，14世纪中叶由反对蒙古统治的地方势力在萨布泽瓦尔建立，名称意为「绞刑架上的人」，带有反抗的意味。它由谢赫与军事领袖共同治理，兼具宗教与共和色彩，控制呼罗珊西部的农业与商路；1381年被帖木儿的军队推翻，其地并入帖木儿帝国。
politics.en: The Sarbadars were a movement and state in Khorasan that arose after the collapse of the Ilkhanate, established in the mid-fourteenth century at Sabzavar by local forces opposed to Mongol rule, their name meaning those with their heads on the gallows and carrying a sense of resistance. Governed jointly by sheikhs and military leaders and combining religious and republican features, they controlled the farming and trade routes of western Khorasan; in 1381 they were overthrown by the armies of Timur and their lands were incorporated into his empire.

economy.zh: 经济以呼罗珊西部的农业、灌溉工程与商路贸易为基础，萨布泽瓦尔处在连接伊朗内陆与中亚的商道上，谷物、干果与纺织品是重要交换物，关税与地租是主要财源。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in western Khorasan, irrigation works and trade along the routes, with Sabzavar on the roads linking the Iranian interior with Central Asia, grain, dried fruit and textiles among the goods exchanged, and customs and land revenue the main sources of income.

culture.zh: 萨尔巴达尔时期什叶派与苏菲传统在社会中影响扩大，地方宗教领袖参与治理，波斯语文学与史学延续，清真寺与经学院见于记载，其反抗叙事在后世伊朗史学中受到重视。
culture.en: In the Sarbadar period Shia and Sufi traditions gained influence in society, local religious leaders taking part in government, Persian literature and history writing continuing, mosques and colleges being recorded, and their story of resistance receiving attention in later Iranian historiography.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14世纪中叶政权的建立、谢赫与军事领袖共治的制度、对呼罗珊商路的控制，以及1381年被帖木儿推翻，这些事件构成伊儿汗国瓦解后伊朗地方政权兴起的历史。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the state in the mid-fourteenth century, its joint government by sheikhs and military leaders, its control of the trade routes of Khorasan and its overthrow by Timur in 1381, events that make up the history of the local states that arose after the collapse of the Ilkhanate.

value.en: It was overthrown by Timur in 1381.

en: The Qasim Khanate, also known as the Tsardom of Kasimov, as a Tatar khanate within the Russian state
Its rule by the Qasim dynasty and its role as a buffer on the Oka
zh: 卡西姆汗国又称卡西莫夫沙皇国，是俄罗斯国家内的鞑靼汗国
由卡西姆王朝统治，在奥卡河一带充当缓冲

politics.zh: 卡西姆汗国又称卡西莫夫沙皇国，是俄罗斯国家内的鞑靼汗国，1452年由莫斯科大公瓦西里二世将卡西莫夫一带封给鞑靼王子卡西姆建立，作为莫斯科与喀山之间的缓冲与军事力量来源。它的统治者为莫斯科提供骑兵与外交中介，参与对喀山、克里米亚及立陶宛的行动；1681年其王朝绝嗣后并入俄国，鞑靼贵族逐步融入俄国贵族体系。
politics.en: The Qasim Khanate, also known as the Tsardom of Kasimov, was a Tatar khanate within the Russian state, established in 1452 when Vasily II of Moscow granted the Kasimov area to the Tatar prince Qasim as a buffer between Moscow and Kazan and a source of military force. Its rulers supplied Moscow with cavalry and diplomatic intermediaries and took part in campaigns against Kazan, the Crimea and Lithuania; after its dynasty died out in 1681 it was incorporated into Russia and its Tatar nobility gradually merged into the Russian nobility.

economy.zh: 经济以奥卡河沿岸的农业、畜牧、毛皮与鱼类贸易以及服务于俄国宫廷的俸给为基础，卡西莫夫是行政与商业中心，鞑靼贵族依靠土地与俸禄维持生活，河运连接伏尔加与莫斯科方向。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming along the Oka, herding, the fur and fish trades and stipends from the Russian court, with Kasimov an administrative and commercial centre, the Tatar nobility living from land and salaries, and river transport linking the Volga with the direction of Moscow.

culture.zh: 卡西姆汗国的鞑靼精英保留伊斯兰信仰与突厥语文化，清真寺与陵墓在卡西莫夫留下遗存，与俄国王室联姻带来文化互动，手稿与文书显示其在俄国行政体系中的特殊地位。
culture.en: The Tatar elite of the khanate kept their Islamic faith and Turkic culture, mosques and tombs surviving at Kasimov, marriages with the Russian royal house bringing cultural interaction, and manuscripts and documents showing its special place in the Russian administrative system.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1452年封地的建立、15至16世纪为莫斯科提供的军事与外交服务、17世纪王朝的衰落，以及1681年绝嗣后并入俄国，这些事件决定了该汗国的历史地位。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the appanage in 1452, the military and diplomatic services it provided to Moscow in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, the decline of its dynasty in the seventeenth and its incorporation into Russia after 1681, events that determined its historical standing.

value.zh: 1452年由莫斯科大公封给鞑靼王子卡西姆。
value.en: It was established in 1452 when Moscow granted the area to the Tatar prince Qasim.
After its dynasty died out in 1681 it was incorporated into Russia.

en: Kazakhstan, officially the Republic of Kazakhstan, as a landlocked country situated mainly in Central Asia
Its vast territory from the Caspian Sea to the Altai and its borders with Russia, China, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan
zh: 哈萨克斯坦正式称哈萨克斯坦共和国，是主要位于中亚的内陆国家
领土自里海延伸至阿尔泰山，邻俄罗斯、中国、吉尔吉斯斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦与土库曼斯坦

politics.zh: 哈萨克斯坦共和国是主要位于中亚的内陆国家，领土自里海延伸至阿尔泰山，邻俄罗斯、中国、吉尔吉斯斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦与土库曼斯坦，首都为阿斯塔纳。它在中世纪有钦察与金帐汗国传统，15世纪形成哈萨克汗国，19世纪被俄国吞并，1936年成为苏联加盟共和国，1991年独立；此后推行市场经济与多边外交，是欧亚经济联盟与上海合作组织成员。
politics.en: Kazakhstan, officially the Republic of Kazakhstan, is a landlocked country situated mainly in Central Asia, stretching from the Caspian Sea to the Altai and bordered by Russia, China, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan, with Astana as its capital. It has Kipchak and Golden Horde traditions from the Middle Ages, a Kazakh khanate took shape in the fifteenth century, it was annexed by Russia in the nineteenth and became a Soviet republic in 1936 and independent in 1991; since then it has pursued a market economy and multi-vector diplomacy and is a member of the Eurasian Economic Union and the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation.

economy.zh: 经济以石油与天然气、铀与金属矿产、农业与服务业为基础，里海与田吉兹等油气田是主要财源，铀产量居世界前列，小麦与牲畜是重要农产品，采矿业与出口导向经济联系紧密。
economy.en: The economy rests on oil and gas, uranium and metal ores, farming and services, with the Caspian and Tengiz fields the main sources of revenue, uranium output among the largest in the world, wheat and livestock among the important farm products, and mining closely tied to an export-oriented economy.

culture.zh: 哈萨克斯坦文化以哈萨克语与俄语并用、伊斯兰传统与游牧遗产为基础，阿肯弹唱与史诗传统著名，马术与毡房文化延续，多民族社群并存，草原考古遗址与丝路城市留下遗产。
culture.en: Kazakh culture rests on the use of both Kazakh and Russian, Islamic tradition and nomadic heritage, with the art of the akyn and epic tradition well known, horsemanship and yurt culture continuing, many communities coexisting, and steppe archaeological sites and Silk Road cities leaving a heritage.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪哈萨克汗国的形成、19世纪被俄国吞并、1936年成为苏联加盟共和国、1991年独立，以及此后迁都与经济改革，这些事件塑造了现代哈萨克斯坦。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the Kazakh khanate in the fifteenth century, annexation by Russia in the nineteenth, the Soviet republic of 1936, independence in 1991 and the later move of the capital and economic reforms, events that have shaped modern Kazakhstan.

en: Tajikistan, officially the Republic of Tajikistan, as a landlocked country in Central Asia
Its mountainous territory and its borders with Afghanistan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and China
zh: 塔吉克斯坦正式称塔吉克斯坦共和国，是中亚内陆国家
国土以山地为主，邻阿富汗、乌兹别克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦与中国

politics.zh: 塔吉克斯坦共和国是中亚内陆国家，国土以山地为主，邻阿富汗、乌兹别克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦与中国，首都为杜尚别。它在中世纪属萨曼王朝与布哈拉汗国等政权，19世纪被俄国征服，1929年成为苏联加盟共和国，1991年独立；1992至1997年经历内战，此后逐步稳定，水电与铝业是重要经济部门。
politics.en: Tajikistan, officially the Republic of Tajikistan, is a landlocked country in Central Asia with a mainly mountainous territory, bordered by Afghanistan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and China, and with Dushanbe as its capital. In the Middle Ages it belonged to the Samanid state and the khanate of Bukhara among others, was conquered by Russia in the nineteenth century, became a Soviet republic in 1929 and became independent in 1991; it went through a civil war from 1992 to 1997 and has since become more stable, with hydropower and aluminium important sectors of the economy.

economy.zh: 经济以铝冶炼、水电、棉花种植与侨汇为基础，铝是主要出口品，水力资源丰富而开发有限，棉花是重要农产品，在俄罗斯等国的劳工侨汇对家庭收入作用明显。
economy.en: The economy rests on aluminium smelting, hydropower, cotton growing and remittances, with aluminium the leading export, water resources abundant but only partly developed, cotton the main farm product, and remittances from workers abroad clearly important to household incomes.

culture.zh: 塔吉克斯坦文化以塔吉克语、波斯文学传统与伊斯兰教为基础，萨曼王朝被视为民族国家的重要源头，诗歌与音乐传统深厚，帕米尔高原的诸语言与习俗独特，手工艺与织造延续。
culture.en: Tajik culture rests on the Tajik language, the Persian literary tradition and Islam, the Samanid state being regarded as an important origin of the national state, its poetry and music deeply rooted, the languages and customs of the Pamir plateau distinctive, and its crafts and weaving continuing.

events.zh: 关键节点包括中世纪萨曼王朝与布哈拉汗国的统治、19世纪被俄国征服、1929年成为苏联加盟共和国、1991年独立，以及1992至1997年的内战与战后重建，这些事件塑造了现代塔吉克斯坦。
events.en: Key moments are the rule of the Samanids and the khanate of Bukhara in the Middle Ages, the Russian conquest of the nineteenth century, the Soviet republic of 1929, independence in 1991 and the civil war of 1992 to 1997 with the reconstruction that followed, events that have shaped modern Tajikistan.

en: Colchis as a region and kingdom in classical antiquity on the eastern Black Sea coast
Its place in Greco-Roman geography and its later absorption into the kingdoms of the region
zh: 科尔基斯是古典时代黑海东岸的地区与王国
在希腊罗马地理记载中地位重要，后并入该地区诸王国

politics.zh: 科尔基斯是古典时代黑海东岸的地区与王国，位于今格鲁吉亚西部，公元前1千纪由本地族群建立政权，以库塔伊西一带为中心。它凭借黑海沿岸的港口与内陆河谷的农业与金属资源发展贸易，与希腊殖民城市、波斯及本都王国互动；公元前1世纪后先后受本都、罗马与本地诸王国影响，其地成为拉齐卡等政权的基础。
politics.en: Colchis was a region and kingdom in classical antiquity on the eastern Black Sea coast, in what is now western Georgia, where a local polity took shape in the first millennium BC with Kutaisi and its surroundings as its centre. It developed trade through its Black Sea ports and the farming and metal resources of its inland valleys and interacted with Greek colonies, Persia and the kingdom of Pontus; after the first century BC it came under the influence of Pontus, Rome and local kingdoms in turn and its lands became the basis of states such as Lazica.

economy.zh: 经济以黑海沿岸的港口贸易、河谷农业、金属与木材资源为基础，法西斯等港口连接希腊世界与内陆，谷物、木材、黄金与奴隶是重要交换物，河流便利运输。
economy.en: The economy rested on port trade along the Black Sea, valley farming and metal and timber resources, with harbours such as Phasis linking the Greek world with the interior, grain, timber, gold and slaves among the goods exchanged, and rivers easing transport.

culture.zh: 科尔基斯在希腊神话与地理记载中地位突出，金羊毛传说与其相联系，希腊殖民城市带来文字与工艺，本地语言与信仰延续，考古发现显示与希腊及波斯的物质文化交流。
culture.en: Colchis holds a prominent place in Greek myth and geography, the legend of the Golden Fleece being associated with it, Greek colonial cities bringing writing and crafts, local languages and beliefs continuing, and archaeological finds showing material and cultural exchange with Greece and Persia.

events.zh: 关键节点包括公元前1千纪本地政权的形成、与希腊殖民城市及波斯的互动、公元前1世纪后受本都与罗马影响，以及此后成为拉齐卡等政权的基础，这些事件构成黑海东岸古代政治史。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the local polity in the first millennium BC, its dealings with the Greek colonies and Persia, the influence of Pontus and Rome after the first century BC and its later place as the basis of states such as Lazica, events that make up the ancient political history of the eastern Black Sea coast.

value.en: It lay in what is now western Georgia.

value.zh: 与希腊神话中的金羊毛传说相联系。
value.en: It is associated with the legend of the Golden Fleece.

en: The Caucasian Imamate, also known as the North Caucasian Imamate, as a state in the north Caucasus
Its resistance to Russian expansion in the nineteenth century and its defeat in 1859
zh: 高加索伊玛目国又称北高加索伊玛目国，是北高加索的政权
19世纪抵抗俄国扩张，1859年被击败

politics.zh: 高加索伊玛目国又称北高加索伊玛目国，是北高加索的政权，1828年由加齐·穆罕默德在达吉斯坦与车臣地区建立，以伊斯兰教法为基础，由伊玛目领导。它在沙米尔时期达到鼎盛，组织山地部落抵抗俄国军队长达二十余年；1859年沙米尔被俘，伊玛目国解体，北高加索逐步并入俄国。
politics.en: The Caucasian Imamate, also known as the North Caucasian Imamate, was a state in the north Caucasus established in 1828 by Ghazi Muhammad in Dagestan and Chechnya on the basis of Islamic law and led by an imam. It reached its height under Shamil, organising the mountain communities in resistance to Russian armies for more than twenty years; in 1859 Shamil was captured, the imamate broke up and the north Caucasus was gradually incorporated into Russia.

economy.zh: 经济以山地畜牧、梯田农业、手工业与山口通道贸易为基础，村落以石砌建筑与梯田为特色，武器制造与毛毡工艺发达，战时动员与宗教捐税支撑政权运转。
economy.en: The economy rested on mountain herding, terraced farming, crafts and trade through the mountain passes, with villages characterised by stone buildings and terraces, weapon making and felt working well developed, and wartime mobilisation and religious dues supporting the running of the state.

culture.zh: 高加索伊玛目国以伊斯兰教法与地方习惯法结合治理，阿拉伯语与高加索诸语言并用，苏菲教团在社会中影响深远，口传诗歌与史诗记录抵抗历史，建筑与防御塔楼留下遗存。
culture.en: The imamate was governed by a combination of Islamic law and local customary law, Arabic and the Caucasian languages both being used, Sufi orders deeply influential in society, oral poetry and epic recording the history of resistance, and its buildings and defensive towers surviving as remains.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1828年伊玛目国的建立、沙米尔时期的长期抵抗、俄国军队的逐步推进，以及1859年沙米尔被俘与政权解体，这些事件决定了北高加索并入俄国的进程。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the imamate in 1828, the long resistance under Shamil, the gradual advance of Russian armies and the capture of Shamil and break-up of the state in 1859, events that determined the incorporation of the north Caucasus into Russia.

value.en: It was founded by Ghazi Muhammad in 1828.
It broke up after Shamil was captured in 1859.

en: The Principality of Iberia as an early medieval regime in the core Georgian region of Kartli
Its rule by local princes after the end of the Iberian kingdom and its path towards the Bagrationi state
zh: 伊比利亚王公国是格鲁吉亚卡尔特利核心地区的早期中世纪政权
在伊比利亚王国结束后由本地王公统治，后走向巴格拉季昂王朝

politics.zh: 伊比利亚王公国是格鲁吉亚卡尔特利核心地区的早期中世纪政权，6世纪在伊比利亚王国被萨珊波斯废黜后形成，由本地王公（erismtavari）统治，以姆茨赫塔与第比利斯一带为中心。它在拜占庭与波斯之间周旋，8世纪后逐步摆脱外部控制；9世纪起巴格拉季昂家族兴起，其地后来成为统一的格鲁吉亚王国的基础。
politics.en: The Principality of Iberia was an early medieval regime in the core Georgian region of Kartli, formed in the sixth century after the kingdom of Iberia was abolished by the Sasanians and ruled by local princes, the erismtavari, with Mtskheta and the Tbilisi area as its centre. It manoeuvred between Byzantium and Persia and after the eighth century gradually escaped outside control; from the ninth century the Bagrationi family rose to power and its lands later became the basis of a unified Georgian kingdom.

economy.zh: 经济以库拉河谷的农业、葡萄种植、手工业与商路贸易为基础，姆茨赫塔与第比利斯处在连接高加索南北的商道上，谷物、葡萄酒与丝织品是重要交换物，关税与城镇经济支撑财政。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming in the Kura valley, vine growing, crafts and trade along the routes, with Mtskheta and Tbilisi on the roads linking the north and south Caucasus, grain, wine and silk among the goods exchanged, and customs and urban economy supporting public finances.

culture.zh: 伊比利亚王公国时期格鲁吉亚文字与基督教文化发展，教堂与修道院建筑留下遗存，格鲁吉亚语文献与圣徒传开始成形，与拜占庭及波斯的文化互动明显，为格鲁吉亚文学传统奠定基础。
culture.en: In the period of the principality Georgian writing and Christian culture developed, church and monastery buildings surviving as remains, Georgian texts and lives of saints beginning to take shape, cultural interaction with Byzantium and Persia evident, and a basis being laid for the Georgian literary tradition.

events.zh: 关键节点包括6世纪王公国的形成、在拜占庭与波斯之间的周旋、8世纪后摆脱外部控制，以及9世纪巴格拉季昂家族的兴起，这些事件构成格鲁吉亚国家形成的前史。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the principality in the sixth century, its manoeuvring between Byzantium and Persia, its escape from outside control after the eighth century and the rise of the Bagrationi family in the ninth, events that make up the prehistory of the formation of the Georgian state.

value.zh: 位于卡尔特利核心地区，以姆茨赫塔与第比利斯一带为中心。
value.en: It lay in the core region of Kartli, centred on Mtskheta and the Tbilisi area.

value.zh: 9世纪起巴格拉季昂家族兴起。
value.en: From the ninth century the Bagrationi family rose to power.
